The origin record is the B2 line in CairnCommons/slates/2026-09-10-the-gates-are-deterministic-and-one-hand-still-writes-crossings.json, and the site is cairn/devices/tester/cli.py:434 whose measured behaviour is recorded in `measured_at_cast`.

watchme.trigger: TWO readings, files-and-a-function only, no device and no network. (1) THE BEHAVIOUR: call the store's guard predicate with a standing `open` and a measured incoming and assert it refuses — taken the way the sibling probe cairn/devices/tester/probes/a_first_seal_is_taken_under_the_seal.py takes its decision reading, so a refactor that moves the guard and loses it fires this rather than a source-grep a rename would fool. (2) THE ARITHMETIC: census the corpus for validations standing at `open`, and separately count validations standing at a MEASURED seal whose evidence carries the conversion reason. Fire when `open` readings have disappeared since arming faster than reasons have appeared for them — (54 - open_now) > reasoned_conversions. The arithmetic is necessary because the store REPLACES rather than appends: a converted record leaves no superseded `open` behind, so an unreasoned conversion is invisible in the record itself and visible only as a population that shrank with nothing accounting for it. KNOWN IMPRECISION, carried openly: a deleted or renamed validations file also shrinks the population and would fire this. That is acceptable — the probe deposits and pokes and carries no authority (Law 6), and a fire that turns out to be a rename is a cheap look, where a conversion that fires nothing is the false green this ticket exists against.
watchme.enough: 30 days elapsed since arming with the trigger not firing on any pulse. Thirty rather than seven for the sibling probe's recorded reason: the failure watched for is a HABIT re-forming — reaching for the flag to make a sweep uniform — and a habit needs enough voyages to form in. The elapsed clause is what stops the watch clearing on its first pulse, when the guard trivially holds because no traffic has run against it yet.
watchme.carrier: a verdict artifact against this ticket's falsifier, carrying the open-population arithmetic (baseline 54 at arming vs now), the reasoned-conversion count, the guard's live answer, and the by-verdict population beside it as context (159 sealed / 54 open / 6 no-seal-key, measured 2026-09-10)
